notablePrerequisites:
Quicksilver Gargantuan is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Quicksilver Gargantuan do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Quicksilver Gargantuan.
Activate Quicksilver Gargantuan by tapping it.
When Quicksilver Gargantuan becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Quicksilver Gargantuan's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
